policy: Control uses independent direction draws (one fixed node per step). Public-route adds lead selection using only the opponent/type forecast shown in the map and current party moves/HP. In Quick Run it also responds to visible intent/status. Neither inspects future IVs, shinies, rewards or hidden combat rolls.
notes: Bot results are not human win rates or evidence of retention.
Fresh/upgraded/perfect-shiny cohorts start with one partner; collection-6 is an endowed mixed normal IV-18 roster.
Room schedule is fixed; forecasted species differ by seed and persist. All upcoming guardian supports are public.
Legacy blind-route simulations and the frozen baseline are preserved in separate reports. Their acceptance thresholds are not weakened or reused as fixed-route win-rate claims.
Comparison of policies combines lead planning and, in Quick Run, visible-intent use. It is not an isolated experiment measuring only map previews.
Quick Run has one guardian battle; Journey has three.
